entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding with VeloFit. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi Alex. I'm just... I'm so confused. I bought this jersey a while ago, and I was looking at your website, and I don't understand the policy at all. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can certainly help clear things up for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
It's just the wrong size. I finally wore it on a longer ride and it's just way too tight across the chest. I was hoping I could possibly do an exchange for a larger size.
I understand completely; getting the right fit is essential. Let me just pull up your order information to check the return eligibility. Do you have your order number handy?
I think so... hold on. It's... 78-451-92B.
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order here. It looks like it was delivered 67 days ago. Let me just confirm our current policy for you.
Alright, good news. That jersey is a standard apparel item, and it falls under our 90-day return window. You are well within the timeframe to make a return.
Oh, really? That's a relief! So I can send it back?

Yes, absolutely. I'm processing the exchange for you now and I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email on file. Just package the original item, apply that label, and we'll send out the new size as soon as we receive it.
Wow, thank you so much, Alex! You've made this so simple. I really appreciate your help.
You're very welcome. I'm glad I could sort that out for you. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
My pleasure. Have a wonderful day!
